q: What kind of projects does Hatify Labs take on?
a: Usually the involved ones: multi-tenant SaaS platforms, production LLM and RAG systems, voice agents, public-sector ERPs, regulated data platforms and heavy automation. If a project has made other vendors hesitate, it is probably worth a conversation with us.

q: Do you work with government and regulated industries?
a: Yes. We have built ERP systems for the public sector and design HIPAA-conscious architectures for healthcare data. We are comfortable with on-premise deployments, strict audit requirements and the documentation that comes with them.

q: How do you handle data security?
a: From the first sprint. Encryption at rest and in transit, least-privilege access, tenant isolation (up to a database per tenant), audit trails and secrets management are standard in everything we build. Adding security later always costs more than building it in.

We work in three ways: fixed-scope builds for well-defined projects, monthly retainers for ongoing product work, and dedicated teams for long-running programmes. Each engagement opens with a scoped discovery, so the estimate rests on real information.

q: Can you take over an existing codebase?
a: Yes. We begin with a technical audit of the architecture, security, performance and test coverage, then agree a stabilisation plan before adding features. We take over systems carefully and only rewrite what genuinely needs it.

Usually soon after a first conversation. The exact date depends on scope and team availability. For urgent production issues such as outages, security concerns or launch deadlines, tell us in your message and we will prioritise the reply.
